name: nightly
does: the full run on main (D411): clippy and every test, the kits, the artifacts ratchet over every scene, fuzz over seeds 0 to 200, sizes, the scorecards and docs; lowers the baselines and pushes that alone when all pass, bisects a failure; .git/terra-nightly/report.txt. At most every 3 hours, as it takes most of an hour

name: fire
does: the fire sheet against its held baseline, tools/fire/held.json (D415)

name: groundlight
does: a campfire's hearth light brightens the yard's ground beside it, against the far ground, and its firelit stones read orange, not salmon pink (tools/sandbox/groundlight.ts)

name: indoorlight
does: a closed dungeon room and corridor are as bright at noon as at midnight and their unlit corners near black: their rooms' probes, not the forest's sky volume, light them (D485, D486; tools/sandbox/indoorlight.ts)

name: debug menu
does: the debug menu works as a person uses it, at the high preset (D81; tools/sandbox/menucheck.ts): the backtick opens it over the game, a click on a slider sets its tunable and changes the sky, the remote's value shows on it, its reset and the backtick work

name: debug menu low
does: the same at the low preset, whose world is drawn at 0.6 of the screen and scaled up: the menu is drawn over it at the screen's own size; the drift slider, as the low sky has no heaped clouds

name: combat film
does: the combat scorecard with the yard duel's film (D452): every criterion of tools/combat/criteria.json, the film's checks among them, held to tools/combat/baseline.tsv

name: controller film
does: the controller scorecard with the in-game filmed course (D457): the yard's steps, mound, base and drop jogged and sprinted (tools/controller/yard.ts), step smoothing, feet sliding and the yard's own criteria held to tools/controller/baseline.tsv with every cheap row
